recognize_zh: 箭頭所指為核質開放、可見核仁、細胞質淡灰的母細胞；周圍紅系前驅細胞染色質粗塊狀，部分呈雙核或核出芽，母細胞與紅系發育不良並存，符合 AML 伴骨髓發育不良相關變化。
features: Arrow indicates a blast with open chromatin, visible nucleolus and pale grey agranular cytoplasm
Numerous additional blast-like cells with fine chromatin, nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Erythroid precursors with coarse clumped chromatin, including binucleate forms and nuclear budding
Granulocytic precursors with cytoplasmic granules; occasional eosinophil at bottom
Hypercellular smear with red cells in background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular population containing increased blasts, one of which is highlighted by the arrow and shows open chromatin, a visible nucleolus and pale agranular cytoplasm. Numerous erythroid precursors with coarse chromatin are present, some with binucleation and nuclear budding indicating dyserythropoiesis. Granulocytic precursors and an eosinophil are also seen. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes, subject to blast enumeration and genetic studies.

ddx.vs: MDS-IB shows the same dysplasia but with blasts <20%, requiring a formal blast count to separate from AML.

ddx.dx: AML with defining genetic abnormality (e.g. NPM1-mutated AML)
ddx.vs: Multilineage dysplasia can occur in NPM1- or biallelic CEBPA-mutated AML, which take precedence over myelodysplasia-related classification by molecular testing.
Morphology is similar, and the distinction relies on a history of prior cytotoxic chemotherapy or radiation.
